input: File a claim for the damaged luggage from my flight

gold.taskTitle: File a damaged luggage claim for your flight
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to file a claim for luggage that was damaged during a flight.

questions.title: Which airline were you flying with?
questions.description: Identify the specific airline responsible for handling the luggage claim.

questions.title: When did the flight take place?
questions.description: Determine the date of the flight to assess claim deadlines and eligibility.

questions.title: Have you already reported the damage at the airport?
questions.description: Find out if a Property Irregularity Report (PIR) was filed at the airport, as this is often required.

questions.title: What specific damage was done to the luggage?
questions.description: Understand the nature and extent of the damage to help frame the claim accurately.

questions.title: Do you have photos of the damaged luggage?
questions.description: Check whether photographic evidence is available, which is typically required for claims.

questions.title: What is the estimated value of the damaged item?
questions.description: Establish the monetary value of the luggage or its contents to determine compensation sought.

questions.title: Do you have your flight booking reference or ticket?
questions.description: Confirm whether the user has the necessary travel documents to support the claim submission.
